notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Pestermite.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
